messages:
kevin: quick follow-up from the 04/02 postmortem re: recurrent autoscaler + KV eviction pattern. propose 3 runbook updates: add immediate triage commands, add owner assignment flow, add 'pattern match' flag in PM template.

maggie: agree. triage commands should be minimal and safe.

devon: suggested commands:
redwoodctl cache stats --ns=inference --prefix=kv
redwoodctl model variants --model=redwood-alpha
kubectl -n inference describe hpa inference-hpa
# health latency
curl -sS -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://inference.svc/healthz

anya: owners: devon -> runbook edits (48h), kevin -> pattern board ticket + link (24h), maggie -> update PM template (EOD). I'll add an integration test to validate cache stats parsing (5d).

kevin: add 'escalate after 20m to runtime lead' as part of oncall checklist. after-hours SMS step too.

ops-bot: Created INCIDENT-4999 "Runbook: autoscaler+kv triage + pattern flag" assigned to kevin, due 2026-04-05.

maggie: thanks -- I'll post checklist to incidents board and close thread unless blockers.
